title: ClassificationResult
description: Result of classify(image). Matches the decision fields of PhotoCheckResultRequest in docs/contracts/openapi.yaml (BE-1); lease_token is added by the transport layer, not here. The worker never returns a boolean: outcome is safe (publish), unsafe (reject) or unavailable (stay pending_check, retry later). unavailable is never treated as safe.

outcome.description: safe -> photo_state approved; unsafe -> rejected; unavailable -> stays pending_check.

category.description: One of the five frozen categories (docs/contracts/enums.md), or 'unknown' (worker-only: the user picks).

confidence.description: Confidence in the completed decision, 0 to 1. Must be null when outcome is unavailable.

provider.description: Which provider produced the result: stub, gemini, groq, or none if no provider could run.
